typography.note: Font sizes and line heights are independent scales; no size/line-height pairs.

breakpoints.note: lower bound of the "-n-above" custom media (width >= N).

structure.note: Open Color style ramps (0–12). Semantic props (--text-1, --surface-1…) exist only in the optional normalize stylesheet. No primary: --brand / --link default to indigo.

findings: No property for direction, language or script. Font stacks are Latin system/classic stacks; line heights are seven unitless ratios (0.95–2) and letter-spacing props are Latin tracking.

Sizes are offered three ways — rem (--size-N), px (--size-px-N) and relative ch/em (--size-relative-N, --size-content-N, --size-header-N) — but nothing is bound to a control: the optional button stylesheet sizes itself from the font (padding-block .75ch, padding-inline var(--size-relative-6)), with no height.
Pointer type is exposed as custom media (--touch, --stylus, --pointer, --mouse) in props.media.css, the only touch-related affordance; no minimum target size.
The normalize/button extras use logical properties (118 matching lines in src/).

gaps: No control heights, density modes, focus-ring tokens or semantic colour roles in the core props.
